name: Being a DIK
summary: Top-rated college drama visual novel featuring sharp comedic writing, branching romance choices, mini-games, and remarkably expressive 3D renders.
ranking_rationale: Gold standard of story-first adult visual novels—players routinely praise the comedy, character chemistry, and choice consequences just as much as the explicit scenes.

pricing.free_tier: Intro episode & demo free on Steam
pricing.notes: Sold by Season on Steam (Season 1 complete, Season 2 ongoing / early access via DrPinkCake Patreon).

pros: Genuinely funny writing, memorable cast, and branching path consequences
High cinematic lighting and facial animation quality for Daz3D renders
Optional free-roam puzzles and stat minigames keep pacing lively
cons: Episodic wait between late Season 2/3 installments
College frat setting won't click if you dislike slice-of-life drama
